findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "sanctions-kyb-compliance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sanctions_screening, sanctions_screening_batch, sanctions_changes, check_counterparty, check_payee, wallet_risk, token_risk, company_lei, company_lei_batch, lei_changes, bank_us · Private data: sanctions_screening, sanctions_screening_batch, check_counterparty, check_payee, wallet_risk, token_risk, lei_changes · Public sink: sanctions_screening_batch, company_lei_batch · Destructive: sanctions_changes, lei_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sanctions_screening, sanctions_screening_batch, sanctions_changes, check_counterparty, check_payee, wallet_risk, token_risk, company_lei, company_lei_batch, lei_changes, bank_us · Private data: sanctions_screening, sanctions_screening_batch, check_counterparty, check_payee, wallet_risk, token_risk, lei_changes · Public sink: sanctions_screening_batch, company_lei_batch · Destructive: sanctions_changes, lei_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
